quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that shines bright and warm in the daytime sky!
quests.hint: It rises in the morning and makes shadows when you stand outside.
quests.explanation: Yes! The Sun is correct because it shines bright and warm during the day.
quests.funFact: The Sun is actually a giant star, even though it looks small from Earth!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is soft, white, and floats high in the sky!
quests.hint: It can turn grey right before rain falls.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Cloud is correct because it floats softly in the sky and can turn grey before rain.
quests.funFact: Clouds can look like animals or shapes if you use your imagination!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that has a trunk, branches, and green leaves!
quests.hint: It grows tall in forests and gives us shade on a sunny day.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Tree is correct because it has a tall trunk and green leafy branches.
quests.funFact: A big tree can make enough oxygen for two people to breathe every day!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature event where water drops fall from the clouds!
quests.hint: You need an umbrella when this falls from the sky.
quests.explanation: Yes! Rain is correct because it is water falling from the clouds.
quests.funFact: Raindrops start as tiny ice crystals high up in cold clouds!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that has soft colorful petals and a nice smell!
quests.hint: Bees love to visit this to collect sweet nectar.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Flower is correct because it has colorful petals and a sweet smell.
quests.funFact: Some flowers close their petals at night and open again in the morning!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a huge rocky peak reaching into the sky!
quests.hint: Its very top might be covered in snow, even in summer.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Mountain is correct because it is a huge, rocky peak.
quests.funFact: The tallest mountain in the world is called Mount Everest!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is flowing water moving from mountains to the sea!
quests.hint: Fish swim in this long, winding path of fresh water.
quests.explanation: Yes! A River is correct because it is flowing fresh water that fish live in.
quests.funFact: Rivers often begin as melting snow high up in the mountains!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is soft, green, and covers the ground in a park!
quests.hint: You can run and play barefoot on this in the summer.
quests.explanation: That's right! Grass is correct because it is the soft green plant covering the ground.
quests.funFact: Grass can grow back quickly, even after it gets cut short!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that twinkles high in the night sky!
quests.hint: You can see thousands of these on a clear, dark night.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Star is correct because stars twinkle high in the night sky.
quests.funFact: The Sun is actually a star too, just much closer to us!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that glows softly in the sky at night!
quests.hint: It slowly changes shape from a circle to a thin curve each month.
quests.explanation: Yes! The Moon is correct because it glows softly in the night sky.
quests.funFact: The Moon does not make its own light, it reflects light from the Sun!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature space that is blue and stretches above our heads!
quests.hint: Birds fly through this open space above the ground.
quests.explanation: That's right! The Sky is correct because it is the open space above us.
quests.funFact: The sky looks blue because sunlight bounces off tiny bits of air!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is cold, white, and falls in winter!
quests.hint: You can build a round, friendly figure out of this in your yard.
quests.explanation: Great choice! Snow is correct because it is cold and white and falls in winter.
quests.funFact: No two snowflakes are exactly the same shape!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is hard and found on the ground or in the mountains!
quests.hint: You might skip a small, flat one across a pond.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Rock is correct because it is a hard, solid part of the ground.
quests.funFact: Some rocks are so old they formed millions of years ago!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a huge area of salty blue water!
quests.hint: Waves splash onto the sandy beach next to this big body of water.
quests.explanation: That's right! The Sea is correct because it is a big body of salty water.
quests.funFact: The sea is home to more animals than we have even discovered yet!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is thin, green, and grows on tree branches!
quests.hint: This can turn orange and fall to the ground in autumn.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Leaf is correct because it is the thin green part that grows on trees.
quests.funFact: Leaves use sunlight to make food for the whole tree!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that helps flowers and trees grow tall!
quests.hint: Plants turn toward this to soak up its warm light.
quests.explanation: Well done! The Sun is correct because plants need its warmth and light to grow.
quests.funFact: It takes the Sun's light about eight minutes to reach the Earth!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that carries rain before a rainy day!
quests.hint: You often see this get darker just before a storm.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Cloud is correct because clouds carry the water that falls as rain.
quests.funFact: A fluffy cloud can hold enough water to fill thousands of bathtubs!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that grows from a tiny seed into something tall and strong!
quests.hint: Its trunk gets a new ring every year as it grows.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Tree is correct because it grows tall and strong from a small seed.
quests.funFact: Some trees can live for hundreds and hundreds of years!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature event that makes puddles on the ground!
quests.hint: This waters the plants and flowers outside.
quests.explanation: Great job! Rain is correct because it falls and leaves puddles, then helps plants grow.
quests.funFact: Some rain falls from clouds but dries up in the air before it ever reaches the ground!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that grows from a bud in a garden!
quests.hint: You might pick a bunch of these for a birthday gift.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Flower is correct because it blooms from a bud in a garden.
quests.funFact: There are over three hundred thousand kinds of flowers on Earth!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that people climb to reach the very top!
quests.hint: It takes many hours, or even days, to walk up this tall landform.
quests.explanation: Well done! A Mountain is correct because people climb its steep, rocky sides.
quests.funFact: The air gets colder and thinner the higher you climb up a mountain!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that flows and never stops moving!
quests.hint: Boats can float along this winding path of water.
quests.explanation: That's right! A River is correct because it keeps flowing and never stops moving.
quests.funFact: The longest river in the world is the Nile River in Africa!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that turns brown if it doesn't get enough water!
quests.hint: A lawnmower is used to keep this short and neat.
quests.explanation: Great job! Grass is correct because it needs water to stay green and healthy.
quests.funFact: There are thousands of different types of grass growing all over the world!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that looks like a tiny sparkle far away in space!
quests.hint: People sometimes make a wish when they see one shoot across the sky.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Star is correct because it sparkles like a tiny light far away in space.
quests.funFact: There are more stars in the sky than grains of sand on every beach on Earth!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that circles around the Earth!
quests.hint: Astronauts have walked on this rocky, grey world in space.
quests.explanation: Well done! The Moon is correct because it travels in a circle around the Earth.
quests.funFact: It takes about one month for the Moon to circle the Earth one time!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature space where clouds, the Sun, and the Moon all appear!
quests.hint: At sunset, this space can turn orange and pink.
quests.explanation: That's right! The Sky is correct because the Sun, Moon, and clouds all appear in it.
quests.funFact: The sky turns orange and pink at sunset because of the way light travels through the air!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that covers the ground like a soft white blanket!
quests.hint: This melts into water when the weather gets warmer.
quests.explanation: Great job! Snow is correct because it covers the ground and melts when it warms up.
quests.funFact: Snow can look white, but each tiny snowflake is actually clear like ice!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that can be tiny as a pebble or huge as a boulder!
quests.hint: Mountains are made of many, many of these stacked together.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Rock is correct because it can be tiny like a pebble or huge like a boulder.
quests.funFact: Some rocks came all the way from outer space as meteorites!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object where waves roll onto the sandy shore!
quests.hint: You can hear this whoosh and splash all day at the beach.
quests.explanation: Well done! The Sea is correct because its waves roll onto the sandy shore.
quests.funFact: The sea covers most of our entire planet!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that falls from trees when the wind blows!
quests.hint: You might jump into a big crunchy pile of these outside.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Leaf is correct because it falls from the tree when the wind blows.
quests.funFact: Some trees grow new leaves every single spring!
